System detailed data: DIN 4000/4003/ISO 13399 Parameterization Technology data (cutting values) Graphical component representation 2D and 3D generation in accordance with DIN 4000 and ISO 13399 Import of 2D formats DXF/DWG/BMP/TIF/JPG/GIF/PNG Import of 3D formats STEP/STL Detailed data (e.g. cutting material)

features.title: Management of complete tools
features.text: Based on the individual components, the "Tool data management" function offers graphical and parametric tool assembly according to the tools actually available. In addition, the correct tool assembly according to the parts list/component definition is ensured. This module offers a wide range of options: Management of accessories and parts lists Creation of where-used lists for individual components and complete tools Supported 2D formats: DXF/DWG/BMP/TIF/JPG/GIF/PNG Supported 3D formats: STEP/STL Automatic generation of drawings from individual components from the parts list (DXF with connection points)

features.title: Management of setup sheets
features.text: Setup sheets provide the user with a list of information and resources required for a job. These can be forwarded directly to the warehouse, to the CAD/CAM station or to the machine and used.

features.title: Data import/export
features.text: Importing and exporting tools, individual components and setup sheets, accessories, machine data and other data between the individual ZOLLER products. With the help of import filters, platform-independent data can be imported or exported using postprocessors. Your advantages: Optional connection to third-party systems Process reliability Simple and fast handling thanks to simple structures

features.title: Catalog import of tool data
features.text: Imports tool data from many well-known manufacturers and cloud-based service providers (e.g. CIMSOURCE and GTDE) and can therefore quickly provide 2D/3D graphics, material characteristics and technology data. The tool data can be completed at any time and made available immediately via an export. Using the web service, third-party applications can access the shared database and import newly compiled setup sheets, for example.

features.title: Characteristics list according to DIN 4000
features.text: You can use the complete DIN 4000 characteristic list structure to define your individual components in accordance with standards. This guarantees a smooth exchange of information with external systems such as CAD/CAM and NC simulation systems. This uniform, standardized database is the basis for automatic tool data import. Your benefits: Time savings thanks to automatic tool data import Process reliability through error prevention

features.title: Technology data and features
features.text: The technology data and characteristics module is used for the central and intelligent management of individual components and complete tools. This allows you to catalog your tools appropriately, optimize their use and store cutting values. Maintaining just one database saves time and money. Your advantages: Security through standardized data usage Time and cost savings by maintaining just one database

features.title: Automatic generation of envelope contours from material characteristics
features.text: Thanks to the DIN 4000-based feature structure, 2D drawings and 3D contours can be generated automatically from the features entered or imported in ZOLLER tool management. Changes to your tools (e.g. clamping length) are automatically implemented in the drawings. The 3D contours can be exported and made available to CAD/CAM and simulation systems for collision checking. Your benefits: Fast and reliable tool assembly based on the tool drawing Collision control Time savings and process reliability

features.title: Integration of measuring device
features.text: The BRONZE package includes the integration of a ZOLLER presetting and measuring machine. This enables you to use all the functionalities of the TMS Tool Management Solutions software packages on your ZOLLER machine.

features.title: USB camera
features.text: The ZOLLER USB camera is quick and easy to use and captures tool photos directly at the workstation with freely selectable image sections. Your advantages: Time saving through quick, simple documentation of the tool inventory Visualization possible at all workstations

features.title: Cloud import options
features.text: Your tool data can be imported into the TMS Tool Management Solutions with a single click thanks to the import option from the clouds of providers such as ToolsUnited, NOVO, Machining Cloud, Hoffmann, EWS and others. Depending on which system you use, you can import not only 2D/3D graphics, characteristics and technology data of individual components, but also entire assemblies. Your advantages: Importing instead of typing Maximum process reliability Maximum productivity

features.title: WebService
features.text: The ZOLLER WebService is the communication tool between the ZOLLER database and all interfaces in the network on an http basis! Your advantages: Increased efficiency through fast and individual access to tool data Central tool data organization, no more duplicate data storage necessary One leading database, no information redundancies, no maintenance effort

products.headline: SILVER: Comprehensive management of the tool store
intro: With the SILVER package from ZOLLER, you can start managing your entire tool store efficiently. You always know what is located where, how large the stock is and can easily call up the tool cost figures. In addition to tools and components, the SILVER package also allows you to manage all operating resources such as measuring equipment, devices and NC programs.
Systematic management of individual components and complete tools
Integrated circulation control of all existing tools

features.title: Storage interfaces
features.text: The SILVER package includes interfaces to the ZOLLER Smart Cabinets and also tool cabinets from third-party suppliers. With these interfaces, the various systems can be controlled directly from the TMS Tool Management Solutions. Interfaces: »toolOrganizer« »keeper« »twister« Third-party providers such as BCS Bamberger, Bedrunka+Hirth, Achterberg Toolbase, Gühring-Schranksysteme, Hänel, Kardex, Klingeisen, Lista LEC, Modula, StoretecStoreManager

features.text: With the storage location management module, you always have an overview of your complete tools, tool components and accessories. The storage location management contains a virtual 3D kit with which you can quickly and easily map your warehouse in three dimensions and assign the items to a virtual storage location. Each item created can be managed in terms of stock, giving you a quick overview of the storage location, circulation and current stock. External storage and lift systems can of course be addressed via interfaces. Features: Quick warehouse overview Time saving due to elimination of search and shorter distances 24-hour tool availability Reduction in tool costs

features.title: Storage module »quickPick«
features.text: The »quickPick« warehouse module impresses with its reduced user interface for the simple and fast handling of individual components, complete tools, test equipment, devices, orders and accessories. Stock bookings can be made with just a few clicks. External storage and lift systems can of course be addressed via interfaces. Features: Inventory-based management of all equipment Extremely easy to use, no training required Reduction in search times

features.title: Test equipment management
features.text: This module manages all your measuring and test equipment for the set-up sheet and monitors calibration intervals. Test reports are supplemented by informative graphics and improve the control of the measuring equipment. The logs can be saved to the measuring equipment as required. In combination with stock management, storage locations can be assigned to the measuring equipment and managed graphically.

features.title: Fixture management
features.text: This module is used for the modern management of your fixtures for the setup sheet and stores image information and setup instructions. Fixture variants are managed as parts list information. In combination with warehouse management, storage locations can be assigned to the fixtures and managed graphically.

features.title: NC Program Management
features.text: This module is used to easily manage your NC programs in the ZOLLER database for the setup sheet and offers the option of storing different program versions (version management). Information such as the clamping sketch, workpiece drawing and the solid model can be stored for the NC program. A standard viewer is integrated into the NC program management. Further option: Integration of an external viewer.

features.title: Article statistics
features.text: An analysis of your tool movements and thus transparency in production is the prerequisite for exploiting optimization potential. With the article statistics, ZOLLER provides an overview of the current cost situation of your tool system as well as the distribution of your consumption at the individual cost centers.

products.name: GOLD Shop Floor Management
products.claim: GOLD: For tool data, processes and key figures
products.headline: GOLD: For tool data, processes and key figures
intro: The GOLD package from ZOLLER maximizes the efficiency of your tool data management. You gain full cost control and transparency of your tool management across the process chain. With statistics on individual tools and orders, you control your costs, evaluate them and thus always make the right decisions.
Seamless organization of tool data
Full cost control, transparency and efficiency

features.title: Parts management
features.text: The parts management software module gives you an optimum overview of your components and products. You can systematically manage individual parts and assemblies and document them, including setup sheets with the required tools. The module also provides additional information such as production times and current stock levels of the required tools. Features: A central database for all parts data Transparency of the production steps and the tools required Simple data management

features.title: Ordering system
features.text: Benefit from a practice-oriented and reliable ordering system with this software module. Order only those items that are actually needed in production. By optimizing your purchasing processes, you reduce your storage costs and avoid downtime due to missing items. This reduces your tool and ordering costs. By linking ordering and warehouse management, it is possible to automatically analyze minimum stock shortfalls and generate fully automated order proposals. Features: Reliable execution of orders based on minimum stock levels or purchase requisitions Automated generation of purchase requisitions Time and cost savings through optimized organization and transparency Automatic posting of the delivery to the corresponding cost center

features.title: Order management
features.text: The entire production process is mapped here, starting with order creation, storage and tool preparation, setting and measuring, right through to production.

features.title: Statistics module
features.text: You can use this software module for the graphical evaluation and management of measured values and data records in a freely selectable period in a variety of ways. The complete measurement statistics of a tool are displayed in a clear and informative tree view. The where-used lists of the individual tools are automatically stored in the system. This allows you to verify the areas of application of the tools at any time. A hit-flop list allows you to analyze stock bookings and goods receipts in terms of costs and usage, enabling you to precisely analyze and optimize your tool inventory. Features: Quick overview of measured values and measurement curves Traceability of tool usage Support for quality control in the production process

features.title: Tool life management
features.text: This software module for tool life management with integrated statistics function allows you to optimally monitor your tools and store tool change reasons. A process-specific configuration for optimum utilization of the machine running time is also possible. The statistics function graphically displays the tool life and the reasons for changing the individual tool stages and provides a clear log for a quick overview. Features: Optimum utilization of the machine running time Prevention of expensive rejects Full tool life and cost control Optimum tool utilization

features.title: Tool life monitoring »flash« (optional)
features.text: The ZOLLER »flash« analysis software enables effective tool management and economical organization of cutting tools. By communicating with the CNC machine, »flash« regularly and fully automatically checks the current service life of the tools and color-codes their status. Tools that need to be replaced due to their service life can thus be picked, fitted and preset ahead of time. This avoids quality losses, tool breakage and machine downtime. Features: Full utilization of the tool potential until the tool life limit is reached No machine downtime and time savings thanks to "just-in-time" tool changes Enormous cost savings in relation to the "tool" variable

features.title: Resharpening process
features.text: This software function extends the warehouse function of ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions to include the resharpening process for your stored tools. Benefit from transparent handling of the resharpening process: delivery bills and orders can be printed out, and interaction with the ordering system and the warehouse guarantees a consistent process. Features: Transparency across the entire tool resharpening cycle Recording of resharpening costs

features.title: Cost Per Part (optional)
features.text: A CPP analysis enables a comparison of budgeted and actual costs per part and allows statements to be made about the quality of tools and processes by analyzing downtimes and reasons for changes. The CPP module determines two different key figures: The budgeted CPP is compared with the actual CPP. The calculation includes the definitions of tool life and quantities as well as the purchase prices and the number and costs of resharpening processes. Advantage: Full cost control, transparency and efficiency

products.headline: We Stand for Smart Progress
intro: As a tool manufacturer or grinding company, you have to deliver the best quality. The »genius« universal measuring machine provides you with precise measurement data as unmistakable proof of the high manufacturing quality of your products.

With ZOLLER »genius«, you can measure over 100 parameters of your precision tools in 2D/3D in a non-contact, fully automatic and impressively reliable manner. Every measured value provides you with the basis for improving the quality of your products.
1:1 expert meeting

sections.title: High-Precision Optics
text: With ZOLLER »genius«, you can measure almost anything on tools - precisely, fully automatically and without contact. No matter how complex the tool is.

sections.title: Guaranteed Accuracy
text: The demands in quality management are constantly increasing. That is why you must be able to rely on the constant measuring deviations of your machines. In ZOLLER measuring machines, high-precision calibration standards made of Borofloatglas ® are used to determine the length measurement deviations in accordance with the DIN EN ISO 10360 standard. In accordance with this standard, at least three measuring sequences (25,326 relationships) are carried out. With this procedure, the accuracy of the ZOLLER measuring machines is documented in two dimensions and can be traced at any time.

sections.title: The Fact Check for Tools
text: The »genius« is simple to use and built to last. The Universal measuring machine is designed for long-term measurement tasks in multi-shift operations right on the production floor.
The ZOLLER Inspection & Measuring Solution proves what many claim: quality.

sections.title: Maximum Performance without Effort
text: No measuring machine on the market combines convenient operation and µm-precise geometry data as impressively as »genius«. You too can use this excellent technology from ZOLLER to simplify complex quality inspections on tools.

features.title: Incident light camera
features.text: Incident light camera with multi-LED segment illumination and CNC swivel device - for the inspection and automatic measurement of tool geometries on the circumference, in the chip space and on the face. Simply enter the target parameters in the measuring program dialog and every measured variable is automatically measured and logged: rake angle, clearance angle, groove contour, chamfer width and many other geometries. The high-performance LEDs, segmented into eight areas, are automatically controlled by the measuring system and ensure optimum illumination of the surface thanks to automatic intensity control - for high precision and repeat accuracy.

features.title: Switch cabinet

The camera has a high frame rate for fast focus and contour recording from the tool rotation. The multi-LED ring light ensures high-intensity and high-contrast illumination of the cutting edge inspection in incident light.

products.claim: Precision in the measurement of saw blades
products.headline: Precision in the measurement of saw blades
intro: In the manufacture and regrinding of precision saws, ever higher demands are being placed on accuracy and efficiency.

With the »sawCheck« inspection and measuring machine, ZOLLER offers a solution for measuring saw blades fully automatically, tooth by tooth, with high precision and independently of the operator. When inspecting the teeth, parameters such as tooth shape, pitch, concentricity and runout can be measured in transmitted light. In incident light, for example, the rake angle, clearance angle, tooth thickness, center offset or radial or axial wear can be checked quickly and independently of the operator and documented in detail.

products.name: »edgeControl 600«
products.claim: Determine the degree of wear and save costs
products.headline: Determine the degree of wear and save costs
intro: If tools are used for too long or are replaced too early, this can lead to higher costs. The ZOLLER »edgeControl 600« presetting and measuring machine helps to determine the degree of tool wear.

In addition to the precise setting and measuring of tools, the ZOLLER »edgeControl 600« presetting and measuring machine offers the additional option of taking high-resolution color images in the tool chip space, on the tool circumference and on the tool face using the incident light camera.

products.name: »edgeControl«
products.claim: Detects tool breakage on all cutting edges
products.headline: Detects tool breakage on all cutting edges
intro: Do you want to deliver 100% quality to your customer and/or resharpen efficiently and therefore need to detect chipping or wear on tool cutting edges quickly and precisely?

The ZOLLER »edgeControl« with 3D sensor takes on this demanding task for you. The sensor is aligned fully automatically to the cutting edge and the cutting edges are digitized in 3D, including simultaneous path control of the axes. The subsequent analysis of the 3D model is also fully automatic and can be influenced manually if required.

products.name: »3dCheck«
products.claim: Captures, digitizes and analyzes complex tools
products.headline: Captures, digitizes and analyzes complex tools
intro: ZOLLER »3dCheck« is the perfect inspection machine for fast and process-oriented 3D digitizing.

It opens up new dimensions in the measurement of tools and is also universal, accurate and user-friendly. The ZOLLER »3dCheck« combines the advantages of the optical ZOLLER »Z3dCam« (3DSensor) with high-precision CNC axes and fully automatic transmitted light image processing.

intro: ZOLLER »caz« (computer aided ZOLLER) is a virtual presetting and measuring machine with which you can define the measuring tasks for a ZOLLER presetting and measuring machine directly on a 3D model of the tool.
When designing your tool, you define at which points and how this tool is to be measured after completion. ZOLLER »caz« is a software module that you implement and use directly in your CAD design.

text: The ZOLLER induction coil is an intelligent, well thought-out highlight of the »powerShrink«. The five cooling bells for standard-compliant shrink fit tool holders from D6 mm to D32 mm ensure fast, even cooling thanks to their intelligent design and integrated contact cooling. Your shrink fit tool holders are protected and the high concentricity is maintained.

sections.title: ZOLLER has fundamentally modernized shrinking
text: A new era has begun in shrink technology. We have not only redeveloped the key elements of shrink units. We have brought a generation of devices onto the market that is far superior to all other solutions.
High savings in energy consumption, heating with almost 100% efficiency, extremely fast cooling and clever user guidance - shrinking and unshrinking with ZOLLER redefines an established process.

features.title: 30% energy saving
features.text: With ZOLLER induction technology, you can heat your shrink fit tool holders optimally. For you, this means: evenly over the entire clamping range and only for as long as necessary. This gives you shorter heating and cooling times, shorter cycle times, protects the tool holders and increases their service life. A particular advantage of »powerShrink«, with which ZOLLER is making its contribution to sustainable use in production, is the energy saving of up to 30% compared to the previous model. We are particularly proud of this. The heat and energy is used exactly where you need it to shrink your tools in and out safely.

features.title: When art hits the mark

The ZOLLER induction coil with »varOct« shielding system ensures maximum efficiency and ergonomics in the shrinking process. Ingeniously conceived. Perfectly designed. features.text: In the Z-axis for shrink-fitting to an accuracy of less than 10 μm. Shrink length monitoring - for safe and controlled shrink-fitting of tools with monitoring of the minimum shrink-fit length.

features.title: High-precision spindle »ace«
features.text: High-precision, universal spindle system with machine spindle-like clamping behavior, guarantees the μm-precise holding and clamping of tools. The universal attachment holder change system enables adaptation to almost any tool holder system.

features.title: Cooling bells
features.text: For a safe and easily guided cooling process thanks to the color system of the LEDs. Alternatively, the »redomatic 600« can also be selected with the standard cooling bells. Cooling manager software for the cooling unit - the cooling unit is only switched on automatically when required.

features.title: Auxiliary unit
features.text: For holding the shrink electronics, cooling bells, mounting rings, stop bars and the ZOLLER »masterPiece« setting adapter. The display of the »sls« shrink guide system in the image processing software ensures that the required accessories can be selected quickly. The »sls« – »pilot 4.0« shrink guidance system guides the operator safely and quickly through the shrinking process with the help of precisely predefined work steps in the software.

features.title: »pilot 4.0« image processing software
features.text: The control system consisting of IPC, »pilot 4.0« and 24" TFT color monitor takes over all processing tasks for setting, measuring and shrinking and ensures safe and easy operation. The monitor can be adjusted in height and tilt, making the software as comfortable as possible to use. The »cockpit« offers space for a keyboard and mouse as well as shelves for label and laser printers, scanners and tools such as Allen keys.

gallery.title: 30% energy saving
gallery.text: With ZOLLER induction technology, you can heat your shrink fit tool holders optimally. For you, this means: evenly over the entire clamping range and only for as long as necessary. This gives you shorter heating and cooling times, shorter cycle times, protects the tool holders and increases their service life. A particular advantage of »redomatic«, with which ZOLLER is making its contribution to sustainable use in production, is the energy saving of up to 30% compared to the previous model. We are particularly proud of this. The heat and energy is delivered exactly where you need it to safely shrink and unshrink your tools.

gallery.title: When art hits the mark
gallery.text: Inspired by modern architecture and optical kinematics, ZOLLER's Research and Development department has created a masterpiece. The ZOLLER induction coil with »varOct« shielding system ensures maximum efficiency and ergonomics in the shrinking process. Ingeniously conceived. Perfectly designed. The eight variable elements of the »varOct« coil shielding slide past each other in a closed loop - a design experience. The ZOLLER uniqueness for unbeatable design and efficiency.

gallery.title: Top-class stand-alone solution
gallery.text: Shrink and unshrink tools in record time while saving energy and protecting the shrink fit holder: You get all these benefits with the »powerShrink« inductive shrink system.

products.name: »idChip«
products.teaser: Coded chip with DataMatrix code, permanently integrated in the tool holder
products.headline: The digital identity of your tool holders
intro: The ZOLLER »idChip« is a coded chip made of extremely robust plastic, permanently integrated into the tool holder. Its DataMatrix code makes every holder uniquely identifiable – at the presetting and measuring machine, at the shrink fit machine, in the tool storage and at the CNC machine.

This way you always know everything about your tool holders: number of heating cycles, uses on the machine and much more. Product service life, digital twin and further information are available anytime, anywhere – at costs far below those of RFID transponders.

sections.title: Firmly integrated. Protected in the holder.
text: The »idChip« sits in the chip bore of the tool holder and is bonded in place with two-component adhesive. Together with the adhesive, the 3-groove technology in the chip bore creates a form fit – for a secure and firm connection. This keeps the chip protected while it remains clearly visible.
On ZOLLER Tooling tool holders with HSK-A hollow shank taper, SK steep taper and PSC polygonal shank taper, the chip bore is standard. It takes the »idChip« or other data carriers such as RFID chips.

sections.title: Scan once. Know everything.
text: A single scan of the DataMatrix code is all it takes: the tool is uniquely identified and the associated tool data comes straight from the database. Input errors and mix-ups are a thing of the past.
All you need is a scanner that reads the DataMatrix code and software that manages your tool data. ZOLLER offers both with »zidCode 4.0« and TMS Tool Management Solutions.

sections.title: One code for the entire tool cycle
text: The »idChip« accompanies the tool holder through every station – and ZOLLER solutions recognize it everywhere.

sections.title: »idChip« or »idLabel«?
text: Both carry a DataMatrix code and make tools uniquely identifiable. Which solution fits depends on the application.

products.name: »toolBalancer«
products.teaser: The balancing system with state-of-the-art technology and ergonomic design
products.headline: We stand for smart progress
intro: With optimally and highly precisely balanced tools, you achieve longer tool life, longer spindle life and a better surface quality of your components. With »toolBalancer«, you can achieve the perfect balance of sustainability, efficiency and progress not only for your tools, but also for your entire production process.

sections.title: Reach your destination with safety and speed
text: »toolBalancer« makes tool balancing especially simple: thanks to the ergonomically designed »twinPanel« safety cover, convenient membrane keypad, compartment for balance adapters, and compartments in the large work area.

The ZOLLER operating software with its structured graphic representation intuitively guides the operator through the measuring and balancing process. Using the appropriate software options, all balancing applications are available on 1 to 2 balancing levels, such as fixed position compensation with balancing screws or the use of balancing rings or balancing by material removal such as drilling or milling.

sections.title: From the center to the highest precision
text: An unbalance on tools is caused by an asymmetrical design and the associated asymmetrical mass distribution. The ZOLLER »toolBalancer« solves this problem by using a deliberate center offset in the balancing adapter when measuring and balancing your tools.

The balancing adapter with center offset is designed with a two-point system and a thrust piece. This results in a large and more measurable sensor signal and guarantees high-precision balancing results, especially with high balancing quality and low unbalance.

sections.title: Balancing means peace of mind for tools
text: Vibrations occur when rotating tools do not run smoothly. Even at low speeds, this can lead to increased tool wear, loss of surface quality and additional stress on the machine spindles. Therefore, have your tools regularly checked on a balancing device from ZOLLER.
Find out more about the advantages of ZOLLER Solution balancing.

features.title: »twinPanel« safety cover
features.text: Complies with DIN ISO 21940-23 class C60 for maximum safety. The internal "sacrificial disk" absorbs dirt caused by e.g. The internal "victim disk" absorbs dirt, e.g. residues of cooling lubricants and damage caused by component detachment. This takes into account the very important and often overlooked process of protective disk switching that occurs through daily use. The ZOLLER »twinPanel« guarantees the safety of your operators in the long term thanks to the quick and cost-effective replacement of the sacrificial screen.

features.title: High-precision spindle
features.text: Accepts almost any tool holder with an appropriate balancing adapter. Depending on the weight, the spindle rotates the tool at a variably adjustable speed of 400 to max. 1200 revolutions per minute and measures the unbalance with an accuracy of < 0.4 gmm. When designing the high-precision spindle, ZOLLER placed a particular focus on the safe and certified adapter changing process. A special design element prevents accidents and damage caused by unbolted balancing adapters in the spindle.

features.title: Adapter storage compartment
features.text: Three storage spaces for ergonomic, back-friendly and quick adapter changes without bending your knees.

features.title: Fork recess
features.text: For flexible installation and easy transportation of the »toolBalancer« in your production facility using a pallet truck.

features.title: ZOLLER operating software
features.text: The structured, graphical display guides the operator intuitively through the measuring and balancing process. The machine is set up by entering the tool geometry data. All data is stored in the database and is also available at a later date.

features.title: »cockpit« control unit
features.text: Can be adjusted in height and position and the monitor can be tilted. It can be easily moved to the desired position, making operating the software as convenient as possible. In addition to touch operation, the »cockpit« offers input options via mouse and keyboard, as well as shelves for label and laser printers, hand scanners and tools such as Allen keys.
